title: REGEN: Response Engineering with GEnetic algorithms and Neural networks
description: REGEN is a Windows desktop application for design of experiments: experimental design, response surface methodology (RSM), artificial neural networks (ANN), and multi-objective optimization (NSGA-II and NSGA-III) in one project. It implements a framework with four diagnostic checks: cross-validated selection of the ANN architecture, a learning curve for data sufficiency, a hypervolume-based stopping rule, and a cross-prediction of the ANN and RSM Pareto fronts.
